docs.title: Welcome to DocsForge
docs.text:
One package. One command. Beautiful docs.

DocsForge is a unified documentation site generator that combines the ProperDocs engine with the Material for MkDocs theme.

docs.title: Why DocsForge?
docs.text: Problem Solution MkDocs is unmaintained Uses actively maintained ProperDocs fork Material plugins need manual config Auto-registered — no plugins: list Multiple packages to install Single pip install

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
pip install docsforge
docsforge new my-docs
cd my-docs
docsforge serve

That's it! Material theme + search + tags are pre-configured.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• ✅ Search (auto-enabled)
  • ✅ Tags (auto-enabled)
  • ✅ Blog support
  • ✅ Social cards
  • ✅ Privacy plugin
  • ✅ Dark mode toggle
  • ✅ Responsive design

Built with DocsForge ☄️

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
DocsForge is a repackaging project, not a fork:

  • Engine: ProperDocs (MkDocs fork by @oprypin)
  • Theme: Material for MkDocs (by squidfunk)
  • Glue: Unified CLI + auto-plugin registration

docs.title: Why Not Just Use ProperDocs + Material?
docs.text:
You can! But DocsForge gives you:

  1. One install: pip install docsforge instead of 2+ packages
  2. Zero config: No plugins: list to maintain
  3. Unified branding: One CLI, one config format

docs.title: Status
docs.text:
🚧 Beta — Core merge complete, plugins verified, CLI working.

Built with ❤️ and too much caffeine.

docs.title: Auto-Registered Plugins
docs.text:
DocsForge automatically enables Material plugins without requiring a plugins: section:

Plugin Purpose search Full-text search with lunr tags Tag-based navigation blog Blogging support social Social card generation privacy External resource optimization offline Offline-capable builds optimize Asset optimization

docs.title: Theme Features
docs.text:
• Dark mode — Toggle between light and dark themes
  • Responsive — Works on desktop, tablet, mobile
  • Search — Built-in search with highlighting
  • Navigation — Automatic nav from directory structure
  • Code blocks — Syntax highlighting with copy button

docs.title: Backward Compatible
docs.text:
Existing mkdocs.yml files work unchanged:

site_name: My Existing Site
theme:
  name: material
plugins:
  - search

Just rename to docsforge.yml for the full experience.

Next: About

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
pip install docsforge

This installs: - ProperDocs engine (MkDocs fork) - Material for MkDocs theme - All recommended plugins

docs.title: Build for Production
docs.text:
docsforge build

The built site will be in the site/ directory.
